title: disclosed dispute
description: A graded institution's stated objection to one finding about it, committed as disputes/<unit_id>.json and rendered verbatim beside the finding. A dispute never changes a classification; it is published next to one.

unit_id.description: IPEDS unit id, as the College Scorecard publishes it, and the same as the file name.

field.description: The graded field label this dispute is about, exactly as the report writes it. A field the report does not carry is refused.

disputed_classification.description: The state the report gives that field. Carried so a dispute that has been overtaken by a regrading is refused as stale rather than rendered beside a finding it does not name.

statement.description: The institution's own words. Quoted verbatim on the page and never summarised: paraphrasing would make this project the author of the other side of its own argument.

evidence_url.description: Where the institution says the disclosure is. Rendered as a link and never fetched: whether the page says what the statement says is a judgement, and this channel carries the claim rather than adjudicating it.

filed.description: ISO calendar date the dispute was filed.

filed_by.description: Who filed it, in their own words. An anonymous statement on somebody else's page is not attributable, so this is required.
